changeSet.sql: update dokumentart set belegnummer_muster = array['^(?<jahr>\d{4})-(?<nr>\d{3})$', '^R(?<nr>\d{4})$']::text[] where current_schema() = 'm_urinet' and code = 'AUSGANGSRECHNUNG' and belegnummer_muster = array['^\d{4}-\d{3}$', '^R\d{4}$']::text[];

with aktuelle as ( select inhalt from konfiguration_version order by version desc limit 1 ), arten as ( select jsonb_agg( case when art.wert ->> 'code' = 'AUSGANGSRECHNUNG' and art.wert -> 'belegnummerMuster' = to_jsonb(array['^\d{4}-\d{3}$', '^R\d{4}$']::text[]) then jsonb_set(art.wert, '{belegnummerMuster}', to_jsonb(array[ '^(?<jahr>\d{4})-(?<nr>\d{3})$', '^R(?<nr>\d{4})$' ]::text[])) else art.wert end order by art.position) as wert from aktuelle a cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(a.inhalt -> 'arten') with ordinality as art(wert, position) ), parameter as ( select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'code', code, 'art', art, 'typ', typ, 'parameter', parameter, 'schwere', schwere, 'meldung', meldung, 'aktiv', aktiv) order by code collate "C"), '[]'::jsonb) as regeln from regel ), naechste as ( select coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1 as version from konfiguration_version ), abbild as ( select n.version, jsonb_set( a.inhalt || jsonb_build_object('version', n.version, 'regeln', p.regeln), '{arten}', coalesce(arten.wert, a.inhalt -> 'arten')) as inhalt from aktuelle a, arten, parameter p, naechste n ) insert into konfiguration_version (version, wer, grund, quelle, inhalt, sha256) select version, 'system:migration', null, 'MIGRATION', inhalt, encode(sha256(convert_to(inhalt::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') from abbild where (select regeln from parameter) <> '[]'::jsonb and (inhalt - 'version') is distinct from ( select inhalt - 'version' from konfiguration_version order by version desc limit 1);
